turns.user: Add cat_of_the_day(day=None) to cafe/cats.py. It returns one of the awake cats (a dict from CATS, never a sleepy one), always the same cat for the same date; day is a datetime.date and defaults to today. Add a last line to the receipt: "cat of the day: <name> ♡" (use today's cat). Write tests for it in tests/test_cat_of_the_day.py and run all the tests.

steer.text: oh, one more thing: Pixel is moving to a new home next week, so she should never be the cat of the day.
